rule_title: All RHEL 9 world-writable directories must be owned by root, sys, bin, or an application user.
check_text:
Verify RHEL 9 world writable directories are owned by root, a system account, or an application account with the following command:

$ sudo find / -xdev -type d -perm -0002 -uid +999 -exec stat -c "%U, %u, %A, %n" {} \; 2>/dev/null

If there is output that indicates world-writable directories are owned by any account other than root or an approved system account, this is a finding.
